notes.leased: the outpoint is bound to an action — take()/prepare() refuse it for other actions while the owning tx lives
notes.released: provisional — custody returned the coin, but a refused/expired tx can still air (3bb8271b): late evidence flips it to spent
notes.spent: the outpoint is provably consumed — either our tx confirmed or a refused tx aired anyway and the revive accounted it
notes.guards: spend evidence comes only through the tx.machine intents — a lease never moves on a hint or a status word
